profile.headline: Software Engineer III at LexisNexis Risk Solutions
profile.summary: I am a Web Developer who has spent the last two years growing my knowledge by following my curiosity, and gaining experience with all parts of the Software Development Life Cycle. I am eager to actively contribute to a team, and I have very strong communication skills as well as an unbounded ability to learn. I pursue growth while delivering solutions with confidence and accuracy.

positions.title: Business and Education Advisor
positions.description:
-Assisted business and school admins with managing and enrolling their fleet of Apple devices in Apple Business Manager.
-Helped customer image their devices to be ready for deployment and use by employees
-Resolved permission issues where ex-employees accounts remained on company devices.
-Assisted customers with verifying their domains and volume purchasing and distribution of apps to company devices.

positions.title: Creative Media Advisor
positions.description:
-Assisted Customers with multimedia needs and issues involving Apple's creative suite of applications including Pages,Keynote, Numbers, Photos, GarageBand, iMovie and Final Cut Pro
-Isolated and resolved issues pertaining to the customer's computer or user account

positions.title: Team Manger Backfill
positions.description:
-Lead Team Meetings.
-Documented Advisor goals and developed plans for their KPI and career goals.
-Lead 1 to 1 meetings detailing advisor performance

projects.title: Atelier Design Website
projects.description: Lead a team of 8 developers to design and implement a UX handoff. Create an app with JWT authentication, full CRUD functionality via RESTful API, using React.js to create a website that allows users to upload art and leave comments on art.

projects.title: Choose Your Own Adventure
projects.description: Recreation of classic board game dealing with relational databases, RESTful API, JWT authentication, DOM manipulation.
